<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/service-cluster`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-cluster/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ERROR_CODE_LEDGER (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-cluster/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c5a2484fd42def147949deb94c9a033c37bb66fa` — the merge of head `3a897d94bb3c952bfed2159a71348c54bdfd5eba` into base `35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c5a2484fd42def147949deb94c9a033c37bb66fa && git checkout c5a2484fd42def147949deb94c9a033c37bb66fa
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5 3a897d94bb3c952bfed2159a71348c54bdfd5eba && git checkout -B drift-repro 35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5 && git merge --no-ff 3a897d94bb3c952bfed2159a71348c54bdfd5eba

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 35a9c6941c18eb5597dedd8e27b518050851bdd5` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6f4c42d9bba8c2660eecdd7f4024485eac8a1448`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts + packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts, packages/services/service-cluster/src/index.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-ledger.ts (the narrowing face: every non-prose path of the diff; the two test files were read as evidence, the changeset and the three regenerated `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` are prose faces for the lane seat's ACCEPT)

Faces: schema (`hits` = the ledger) AND a declared narrowing (`Clause-②: … (narrowing)` on the PR body and the changeset). Inputs: card #31602 body and comments 6724399807 (triage), 6727409308 (claim), 6728360014 (os-dev-report, read as the dev's claim); PR #31712 body, file list (11 files) and the net diff against `main` at `3806a5ab` (merge-base of the head); the check-runs on the head. The cloud repository is not readable from this session: R3 and R6 are judged as the card body quotes them verbatim.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Narrowing — RIGHT.** On a deployment where `declaresMultiNode(process.env)` holds (`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS` greater than 1, or `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) and the composed `cluster` service's `driver` is `redis`, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` and `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` answer `409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`. Read in the tree: `handleInstall` calls `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` after `requireInstallCapability` and before `readJsonRequestBody`; `handleUninstall` calls it after admission and before the `manifestId` parse and `this.ledger.has`. This is R6 「多副本时拒绝」 on exactly the two doors the card names, and R3's two conjuncts (declared replicas AND the Redis driver): a single node, `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1`, the in-process driver (escape hatch included), any other driver and no composed cluster service all return `null` from the guard and the doors run byte-identical to `main`.
2. **Derived from 1 — RIGHT, under-declared.** Because the guard sits before the body is read, a `dryRun: true` POST, a malformed body, and the in-process `InstallLocalDoor` grant path (`installForGrant`, the door `cloud-connection-plugin` hands an unmanaged grant to) are all refused with the same 409. On the grant path the existing #31481 audit hand-off records the refusal (`grantRefusalEvent` with the new code and 409) through the `audit` slot when one is composed: that is an audit row of the refusal, not a package change, and "nothing is written, registered or withdrawn" stays true for the ledger, the registry and the kernel. The changeset names "before the body … is read" but does not spell out the dry run (nit, ④.6).
3. **Accept-set widening — RIGHT in the tree, WRONG in the declaration.** `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER['@objectstack/cloud-connection']` gains `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`, so the closed `ErrorCode` union and `ApiErrorSchema.code` now parse one more member (`+365` in the regenerated references). A new ledger code is a published-face widening by the repo's own rule (execution-duties: 「错误码已发布面 = ERROR_CODE_LEDGER/StandardErrorCode:新码恒 yes,无门亦然」). See ②.
4. **Public-surface widening — RIGHT in the tree, WRONG in the declaration.** `@objectstack/service-cluster`'s root gains four exports: `MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER`, `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`, `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, `composedClusterDriver`. Card item 4 asks for exactly this (a named shared predicate #31599 can import), and `packages/runtime/package.json` already depends on `@objectstack/service-cluster`, so the runtime doors can import it without a new edge. `@objectstack/cloud-connection`'s root is unchanged: `CLOUD_BINDING_SHARED_CLUSTER_DRIVER` keeps the literal type and value `'redis'` through the alias.
5. **`sharesCloudBindingCredential` — RIGHT, no behaviour change.** Before: `declaresMultiNode(env) && clusterDriver?.trim() === 'redis'`. After: `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(env, clusterDriver)`, whose body is `declaresMultiNode(env) && clusterDriver?.trim() === MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER` with the constant `'redis'`. Same expression, same two callers (`chooseLedger` in `cloud-connection-plugin.ts` with the composed service's driver, `readCloudBindingCredentialBeforeBoot` with `OS_CLUSTER_DRIVER`), same answer on every topology.
6. **Provenance — RIGHT.** The waiver `(package: service-cluster, code: MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED, registeredUnder: cloud-connection)` holds in the gate's three directions on this head: the cloud-connection key lists the code; the ledger has no `@objectstack/service-cluster` owner key at all; the `constdef` stamp site is the constant's initializer in `multi-replica.ts`. The door's own stamp (`code: MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`, an identifier) is in the gate's declared blind spot, which is the `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` precedent's shape exactly. `check:error-code-provenance` runs in `Lint · docs & code guards`: success on the head.
7. **Error-status conformance — RIGHT.** No scanned docs page publishes a status for this code (nor for its siblings `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `ACCESS_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`), so there is nothing to reconcile and no baseline row is owed; the ledger comment carries the 409.
8. **Unaffected — RIGHT.** Boot rehydrate of the ledger, `GET` list, `reseed-sample-data`, `purge-sample-data` and the `sample-data` count door are not gated: the first reads, the rest write rows every replica shares. The split-brain guard is untouched (R3 「split-brain guard is never weakened」).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/31602-install-local-multi-replica-refusal.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/service-cluster`, `@objectstack/spec` — correct: `Metadata-protocol: none` (no key a metadata author writes changes), and AGENTS.md step 3 ships a non-protocol narrowing as `patch` with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition. Both present; the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker is right (nothing authorable is removed or renamed, nothing to migrate, no tombstone). `Check Changeset`: success.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct on PR body and changeset.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — WRONG value, right arm (should-fix, ④.7).** The diff narrows a published accept set (①.1) AND widens two published faces: a new `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` member (①.3: 「新码恒 yes」) and four new exports of a published package (①.4: 「扩大公开面」). The grammar has the form for exactly this — `clause2-line.mjs`: 「`yes (narrowing)` — a diff that widens one surface and narrows another」 — and merged changesets in the ledger file's own history use it (the `/api/v1/meta/:type` closed query-set PR under ruling 6580261740, among others). The line should read `Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — …` naming both halves, on the PR body and the changeset. Consequence today: none on tier (the narrowing arm and the ledger path each already put the review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, and the arm is what `check:adr-0087-registration` and `reviewFace` read), but a wrong `no` is 「可审计的假申报」 (landing-operations) and the record cannot sign it as right. The seat's claim 6727409308 carries the same `no (narrowing)`; the dev copied it.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` — no login note owed. `Implemented-by` is the dev's branch per the claim (`mode:thread`, dev session `session_01ADHkmPnqZD15YnBkNbm1jJ`).
- Dev deviation 1 (a `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` entry beyond the claim's "one row"): **accepted.** The gate requires it for a constant defined one package over (①.6); it is the precedent's shape.
- Dev deviation 2 (`content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` regenerated): **accepted**, generated output of the new enum member; `check:generated` is inside the green lint jobs.
- Dev deviation 3 (suites run on `03fed7a5`, the head adds only regenerated references): **noted, not relied on.** The head's own check-runs are the gate verdicts. At the time of this record: every Lint job, `Type Check · source gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Spec property liveness`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Build UI Deps` are `success`; `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Test UI (1–16/16)`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check UI`, `Build Core`, `Build & E2E UI` are still `in_progress`; nothing is `failure`. The landing precondition "every check green" is the seat's to read at enqueue time, not this record's.
- Open question 1 (one code for the #31599 doors too?): **A — one code.** Card #31599 D1 itself asks for 「one stable error code」 and 「reuse the predicate … whichever lands second imports the first」; the ledger's own convention is one condition, one code (`ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED`, the `FLOW_*` family), and the client's branch is the same (do it in a maintenance window). Two consequences for #31599, stated here so they are not lost: (i) `@objectstack/runtime` then adds its OWN owner-key row for the code (the ledger rule 「a code emitted by several packages is listed once per emitting package」 — the provenance gate will not demand it, because an identifier stamp is in its blind spot, so the row is the dev's duty, not the gate's), not a second waiver; (ii) the service-cluster waiver's `reason` and the cloud-connection row comment then name both doors. The constant's jsdoc already says each door names its own recipe, which fits #31599's different recipe (「run the change on a single replica or through the CLI, then restart every replica」).
- Open question 2 (keep R6's "run the install script"?): **A — keep the ruling's words; nit, not a fix on this head.** The audience of this refusal is the multi-replica deployment, which is the cloud repository's, and R6's recipe is that deployment's. Nothing in this repository is the script: `os package install` posts to this same door (`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts`), so naming the CLI would point operators at a command the same refusal answers. When cloud names its script, a follow-up adjusts the one line in `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange`. Recorded as an accepted deviation (④.8).
- Open question 3 (refuse dry runs?): **A — refuse, as implemented.** R6 refuses the POST; the guard answering before the body is read is what makes "nothing read, nothing written" hold, and the plan a dry run computes is read from the serving replica's own ledger (`answerUpgradeDryRun` → `this.ledger.read`), the per-replica state the refusal exists for. Refusing at preview time also tells the Console's operator earlier than refusing at install time. The changeset should say so in one clause (nit, ④.6).
- Out-of-scope notes (reseed/purge not refused; `service-cache` keeps its own `declaresMultiNode` + driver read): **agreed**, outside the card; no carrier filed by this record.

### ④ Design judgment

1. **`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` (hits) — holds.** The row is under the door package (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`), the ledger's "the door, not the producer, names the wire vocabulary" rule; its comment states the status (409), the moment (after admission, before body/ledger) and the condition, and the tree agrees sentence by sentence (①.1). 409 is coherent with the rows it sits beside (`UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `ACCESS_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`: a valid request refused by the deployment's state, beside `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`). The waiver matches `ProvenanceWaiverSchema` and the `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` precedent one for one; its `reason` is accurate on this head ("Service-cluster ships no door"). First consumer: `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange`'s `c.json(…, 409)`. No finding.
2. **`packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts` — holds.** `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis` is R3's conjunction and nothing more: "declared" is the split-brain guard's own `declaresMultiNode` (so the two readings cannot drift), "on Redis" is a trimmed equality with `'redis'`, the string `ClusterServicePlugin` registers and the Redis driver reports (`service-cluster-redis` `redis.contract.test.ts` pins `cluster.driver === 'redis'`). `composedClusterDriver` reads the `IClusterService.driver` contract field off the `cluster` slot, swallows the kernel's throw for an empty slot, and answers `undefined` for a non-string driver — never throws, so it can sit in a request path. Its parameter type `{ getService(name): T }` is structurally satisfied by `PluginContext.getService` (`packages/core/src/types.ts`). The jsdoc's "a declaration over the in-process driver still refuses the boot" is true up to `OS_ALLOW_MEMORY_CLUSTER_MULTINODE=true`, which the predicate correctly treats as not Redis and the unit test pins. Tried to break it: a custom remote driver (`nats`, `postgres`) under declared replicas is NOT refused and can still diverge — that is R3's own bound (「接上 Redis 驱动」), recorded as the ruling's accepted consequence, not a finding. No finding.
3. **`packages/services/service-cluster/src/index.ts` — holds.** Four named exports, `[cloud#3814 R2/R3]` comment; no type-only name is shipped as a value. No finding.
4. **`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` — holds.** Guard placement agrees with the ledger comment and the changeset (①.1); the envelope is the sibling refusals' (`{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`, no `data`), which the new test holds against `BaseResponseSchema`, `envelopeViolations` and `ApiErrorSchema`; the driver is read per request where it is used, matching the module's own rule and `chooseLedger`'s init-time read in the sibling plugin. The DELETE guard runs before the `manifestId` 400 and the 404, so an empty id or an unknown package under the condition answers 409 instead — within the declared "right after admission", and harmless (nothing to withdraw either way). The message names door, condition, consequence and recipe and ends with "Nothing was installed, uninstalled or written", true on both doors. No finding.
5. **`packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-ledger.ts` — holds.** Pure delegation (①.5); the exported constant keeps value and literal type; both callers unchanged; `connection-credential-preboot.test.ts`'s topology table still describes the behaviour. No finding.
6. **Nit (prose face) — the changeset's "Now." bullet.** Add one clause that a `dryRun: true` POST is refused as well (①.2, ③ Q3). No effect on correctness or the contract; fix on the prose face or leave as an accepted deviation.
7. **Should-fix (prose faces: PR body + changeset) — the `Clause-②` value.** `no (narrowing)` → `yes (narrowing) — …` naming the narrowing (the two doors' 409) and the widening (the new `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` member; the four `@objectstack/service-cluster` exports). Rationale in ②. No code moves; the arm, the BREAKING banner, the ADR-0087 marker and the `patch` level all stay. The seat's claim comment should be corrected additively alongside.
8. **Nit (accepted deviation) — "run the install script".** R6's words, kept on purpose (③ Q2); follow-up when cloud names the script.

Tests, read as evidence only (lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`): the new `describe` in `marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts` pins both declarations × both doors on a real engine with the cloud leg never fetched and the ledger/registry unmoved, plus the four CONTROL topologies R3 protects; `multi-replica.test.ts` pins the predicate's truth table and `composedClusterDriver`'s never-throw. They match the contract the implementing files state.

Findings: 0 must-fix · 1 should-fix (④.7, prose faces only) · 2 nits (④.6, ④.8). The should-fix earns a delta review of its fix by this reviewer; a prose-only fix keeps this record under the `Regen-provenance:` exception.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `485e8f996ebce01c7fe008677117a7cdfa7ca355`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts + packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts, packages/services/service-cluster/src/index.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-ledger.ts — unchanged bytes since `6f4c42d9`; this is the DELTA review of record 6728523407's should-fix (④.7) and nit (④.6), by the same reviewer. Everything not restated here stands as 6728523407 wrote it.

Regen-provenance: 6728523407 · `6f4c42d9bba8c2660eecdd7f4024485eac8a1448` → `485e8f996ebce01c7fe008677117a7cdfa7ca355` · `git diff --name-only 6f4c42d9 485e8f99` → .changeset/31602-install-local-multi-replica-refusal.md

### ① Derived judgments

- **Head move — prose face only, RIGHT.** `git diff --stat 6f4c42d9 485e8f99`: one file, `.changeset/31602-install-local-multi-replica-refusal.md`, 2 insertions / 2 deletions; one commit, `485e8f99 chore(changeset): declare both halves of the Clause-2 line; note the refused dry run`. No path under `packages/**`, `content/**` or any other face moved, so every derived judgment of 6728523407 ①.1–①.8 carries over byte-for-byte: the narrowing, the ledger row and waiver, the four service-cluster exports, the unchanged `sharesCloudBindingCredential`, provenance and status conformance. Nothing new is derived by a changeset's prose.
- **PR body — patched in place, RIGHT.** The `Clause-②:` line now reads `yes (narrowing) — narrowed, … Widened: …` and names both halves; the `Metadata-protocol: none` line is unchanged; the Verification section states the head move and what it carries.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` × 3, `Metadata-protocol: none`, the BREAKING banner and the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker: unchanged, still right (6728523407 ②).
- **`Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: … Widened: …` — RIGHT on both carriers (the should-fix is fixed).** Value `yes`: the diff widens two published faces, and the line names exactly them — `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` (`@objectstack/spec`) registering `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` under `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, and the `@objectstack/service-cluster` root exporting `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, `composedClusterDriver`, `MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER`, `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`; "nothing is removed or renamed" is true in the tree. Arm `(narrowing)`: the narrowed half is the same two-door 409 sentence as before, so `reviewFace` still reads the narrowing face and `check:adr-0087-registration` still reads the arm beside the marker. The form is `clause2-line.mjs`'s own 「`yes (narrowing)` — a diff that widens one surface and narrows another」. Changeset body and PR body agree with each other and with the tree. The seat's claim 6727409308 was amended additively (6728528676, Clause-② value only) — the audit trail is consistent across claim, PR body and changeset.
